Card Q&A.a: No. When a Digimon is deleted at 0 DP, it's deleted by the game rules, not a card effect, so the game doesn't treat it as if it was deleted by an effect.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon's DP is reduced to 0 by an opponent's effect. Does this card's [On Deletion] effect activate?

Effect: [On Deletion] If this card was deleted by an effect, gain 1 memory.
